archetype: Soft Midnight (Adapted Archetype 5 & 3 for Gen-Z Dark Mode)
design_philosophy: A safe, judgment-free zone that feels like a premium mix of Instagram's clean UI, Reddit's discussion threads, and Discord's real-time interaction. Emphasizes psychological safety through deep, calming dark tones, soft glassmorphism, and playful micro-interactions.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mobile-first, constrained width. The app should feel intimate, not sprawling.
layout_and_spacing.container_dashboard: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

surfaces_and_styles.glassmorphism_card: bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/[0.08] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-3xl
surfaces_and_styles.floating_input: fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[calc(100%-2rem)] sm:max-w-md bg-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-full shadow-2xl p-2 z-50
surfaces_and_styles.ambient_glow: absolute -z-10 w-64 h-64 bg-violet-500/20 blur-[100px] rounded-full pointer-events-none

motion_and_interactions.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -15 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
motion_and_interactions.card_hover: whileHover={{ y: -4, scale: 1.01, borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)' }} transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 25 }}
motion_and_interactions.upvote_trigger: initial={{ scale: 1 }} animate={{ scale: [1, 1.4, 1] }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, type: 'spring', bounce: 0.6 }}
motion_and_interactions.typing_indicator: animate={{ y: [0, -5, 0], opacity: [0.5, 1, 0.5] }} transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 1, staggerChildren: 0.2 }}

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-500 to-blue-500 text-white font-medium rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(139,92,246,0.3)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur-md rounded-full px-6 py-3 transition-colors border border-white/10
buttons.icon_action: p-3 rounded-full bg-transparent hover:bg-white/10 text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors

inputs.standard: w-full bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 text-white placeholder:text-white/40 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500/50 transition-all
inputs.chat: bg-transparent w-full text-white px-4 py-2 focus:outline-none placeholder:text-white/40

components.tags: bg-white/10 text-white/80 text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-white/5 font-medium tracking-wide

media.visual_effects: Since actual 3D generation is skipped, mimic 3D depth by combining lucide-react icons with drop shadows: `drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(139,92,246,0.6)] text-violet-400`

image_urls.description: Friendly teacher avatar for dashboard and chat responses

testing_and_accessibility.data_testids: CRITICAL: Every interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, tabs) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case. Examples: `data-testid="submit-question-btn"`, `data-testid="upvote-icon-btn"`
testing_and_accessibility.focus_states: All focusable elements must have explicit focus states: `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500/50 focus:outline-none`
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism panels maintains APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Use text-shadow if necessary.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build 'Unmute' as a mobile-first, highly polished dark mode application.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn flat cards. Everything must feel layered: use `surfaces_and_styles.glassmorphism_card` for main content blocks.
Implement the 'Ask Question' input as a sticky, floating element pinned to the bottom of the screen (`fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2`).
Use Framer Motion for ALL major state changes: entering the live feed, upvoting a question, and submitting a question.
Place ambient glowing orbs (`surfaces_and_styles.ambient_glow`) in the absolute background to avoid a flat 'black' look.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements for robust testing.
